verdict.rationale: n8n documents an official command-line interface, a public REST API for programmatic control, and Docker-based self-hosting, which together give it its own non-UI path for running automation. The evidence is mostly page titles, though: it never shows headless workflow execution commands or CI pipeline usage. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands for executing or importing workflows headlessly, explicit CI/CD integration guidance or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
